from scratch. ・Leverage the rapid development cycles unique to micro-satellites, executing high-impact technical work at remarkable speed. ・Collaborate closely with hardware engineers in a tight-knit environment to bridge circuit layout and firmware integration seamlessly. ・Work directly alongside executive leadership to gain front-row insight into the strategic and commercial dimensions of the global space industry. ・ Drive international projects in collaboration with diverse partners across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa, and South America, including joint research and development ・Experience developing software using Git ・Basic knowledge of Linux commands ・Ability to engage in technical conversations in Japanese *Knowledge or experience in aerospace engineering or satellites is not required. Preferred ・Experience developing software using Rust ・Ability to read and understand technical documents in English and incorporate that knowledge into design and other tasks ・Experience or knowledge of bare-metal development on platforms such as Cortex-M or RISC-V ・Experience or knowledge of development using RTOS or embedded Linux ・Experience using cloud services such as AWS Ideal Applicants ・High motivation to automate verification and testing processes for systems that integrate both hardware and software. ・Ability to act autonomously while partnering seamlessly with team members across different disciplines. ・Enjoys direct implementation, approaches challenging targets with resilience, and finds genuine fulfillment in achieving ambitious technical goals. ・Autonomous Tech Enthusiast (GEEK): Possesses a natural curiosity to independently research, evaluate, and adopt emerging technologies. -------------------------------------------------- 【Working Time 】 Flextime System 【Holidays & Time Off】 120 days off annually, including: ・Complete weekends (Saturday and Sunday). ・National holidays. ・3 days of summer vacation. ・7 days off for year-end and New Year holidays. ・Other leaves such as bereavement leave and paid time off (as per company regulations) 【Paid Leave】 You'll receive 10 days of PTO after your first month. The company focuses on turning client ideas into distinctive furniture that reflects personal taste and style. Beit Aziz combines thoughtful design with skilled craftsmanship to deliver durable and aesthetically pleasing products. Applicants joining the team will contribute to a creative environment where attention to detail and customer satisfaction are central to every project. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales Engineer role based in Nasr City. The Sales Engineer will work closely with clients to understand their furniture needs, interpret technical and design requirements, and translate them into feasible product specifications. Daily responsibilities include preparing and presenting proposals, coordinating with design and production teams, providing accurate cost estimates, and following up on orders to ensure timely delivery. The role also involves maintaining relationships with existing customers, identifying new business opportunities, and offering technical guidance on materials, finishes, and construction options. The Sales Engineer will document client interactions, update sales records, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to continuously improve sales processes and customer experience. Qualifications Strong technical understanding of furniture design, materials, and manufacturing processes, with the ability to interpret drawings and specifications. Customer-focused sales skills, including consultative selling, relationship building, and effective negotiation in a showroom or project-based environment. Solid communication and presentation abilities, with clear, professional verbal and written skills for interacting with clients and internal teams. Basic proficiency in using office and productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, CRM or sales tracking software) to manage quotations and client data. Relevant education in engineering, interior design, architecture, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in furniture or manufacturing sales. Demonstrated problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines on site. Prior experience in furniture, interiors, or manufacturing sales is highly beneficial; familiarity with the Nasr City market is a plus.
